name: bug-corpus
title_zh: 修完一个 bug，顺手把它变成永久静态检测规则
tagline_zh: 同一个坑踩第二次最亏。它把这次修好的 bug 提炼成 Semgrep/CodeQL/ast-grep 规则留在仓库…
tagline_en: Never step in the same bug twice. It distills a fixed bug into a Semgrep/CodeQL/ast-grep rule that lives in your.
desc_en: Turn a confirmed bug into a permanent static detector. Use when a bug is found or fixed, a regression or root cause is discussed, similar bugs must be found elsewhere, a bug class must be prevented, or a Semgrep/CodeQL/Pysa/ast-grep rule is requested. Runs on `uv run bugcorpus`.
why_zh: 不是记一条 issue 就完事，而是逼你把根因写成可执行的匹配模式，并回扫全库找同类。规则进版本库。
why_en: It doesn't just log an issue — it forces the root cause into an executable pattern, rescans the repo for siblings, and commits.
limit_zh: 只处理已经确认并修好的 bug，没定位到根因的它写不出规则；产出的规则要你自己复核误报，它不替你调阈值。
limit_en: Only works on confirmed, already-fixed bugs with a known root cause; you must review the generated rule for false positives yourself, and it can't.
title_en: Turn each fixed bug into a permanent static detector rule
